models.name: Bonsai 2 9B
models.why: Open optimization challenge (PrismML + DarkbloomAI on Yukon mlx.fast) took ternary Bonsai 2 9B from 144.8 to 959.6 tok/s decode on Apple Silicon in one week, with frozen weights and an exact-token rule.

engines.quant: ternary 2GB weights, frozen; exact-token leaderboard run, speculative decoding (DFlash 2 drafter shrunk to 4-bit); up from 144.8 tok/s on the challenge's mlx.fast track

models.name: Qwen3-1.7B (Woodcock on MLX)
models.full_name: Qwen3-1.7B running AtomicBot's Woodcock speculative drafter on MLX
models.why: AtomicBot's MIT clean-room alternative to Eagle 4 uses a single-layer speculative-decoding hidden-state drafter on MLX; reported to lift SMALL_MODEL generation from 120 to 300 tok/s on an M4 Max.

engines.quant: lossless single-layer speculative-decoding hidden-state drafter (Woodcock, MIT), up from 120 tok/s mlx.fast leaderboard run
